name: Aileen Rawai Townhouses
shortDescription: Off-plan project of 21 two- and three-bedroom two-storey townhouses of about 170-290 sqm in Rawai, by Trinity Property.
description:
Aileen Rawai Townhouses is a project of 21 townhouses by Trinity Property in Rawai, the developer behind the Aileen Villas communities. The advertised homes are two- and three-bedroom units with three or four bathrooms and built-up areas between 170 and 287 sqm.
The site is on Soi Kongngarm, about 3.7 km from Wat Sawang Arom and 3.2 km from Rawai Beach. Shared features are a communal garden, parking, 24-hour security and CCTV; all kinds of pets are allowed.
The payment plan runs from a THB 300,000 reservation deposit through construction stages to handover. Availability differs between portals (about 20 units on one, 2 on another).
